- **AI provider (product owner, 2026-11-10):** comment processing uses OpenRouter with the model `meta/muse-ember` (https://openrouter.ai/meta/muse-ember). This replaces SPEC §10 question 4's default (Workers AI only, through AI Gateway, prompt logging off) and needs an ADR. Known so far: served only by Meta, $0.10/M input and $0.50/M output tokens, not available through OpenRouter's EU in-region routing; zero-data-retention availability and structured-output support are not stated on the model page.
- SPEC §10 question 1 (raw comments or only themes for members) is still the R1 behaviour: members see no comments, the Lead sees redacted raw comments behind N (ADR 0001, 0009). R2 tickets decide what themes change.
- Grilling tickets: call the Skill tool for `grilling` and `domain-modeling`. Research tickets: call `research`. Record hard-to-reverse decisions as ADRs.
- Trust before features (SPEC §3.1): when a choice trades anonymity for convenience, anonymity wins. Anything sent to a third party is a new data flow and must be stated plainly to members.

## Decisions so far

- [What is in and out of Release 2?](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/86): Themes at Round close behind N (Lead keeps raw redacted comments, members see themes only); redaction stays rule-based; AI opt-in per Organization and disclosed to members; discussion guide by rules plus optional AI, Lead only; overview is one Team over time with Action markers; delayed sharing is a Lead review with automatic sharing after 3 days; history page shows participation from the server and answers only from the member's browser; German for app, answer page, and emails, per Person; no R1 deferrals; the first real Round starts early in R2.
- [Can OpenRouter with meta/muse-ember process comments within SurveyBeat's privacy rules?](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/87): No: Meta, its only host, keeps prompts 30 days in the US. ADR 0015: `anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` through OpenRouter with `provider.zdr: true`, pinned to `google-vertex/europe` and `amazon-bedrock/eu-west-1`, no fallback, only redacted text sent, about $0.0015 per Round, off by default per Organization.
- [What are comment themes, who sees them, and how do they keep anonymity?](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/88): ADR 0016. Computed once at close behind N; at most 5; each needs 2+ comments; no quotes (6-word-run check); members see label and sentence, the Lead also counts and raw redacted comments; no Lead edits; retry up to 24 h.
- [What does delayed sharing delay, and for whom?](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/89): Review window 0–7 days per Pulse (default 3); the Lead shares or it shares automatically; members see a "being reviewed" notice; results-ready email at share.
- [How can a member see their own history without linking them to their anonymous Submissions?](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/90): ADR 0017. Participation from the server, own answers only from the browser (1 year, clearable), shown next to shared Team scores above N.

- [How is German added to the app, the answer page, and emails?](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/93): ADR 0018. Typed per-locale catalogs, Person → browser → Organization language, per-locale prerendered answer pages, informal du, bilingual Template, language never stored with a Submission.
- [What is the discussion guide, and is it generated?](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/92): ADR 0019. AI-written in the same call as themes, behind N with AI on; four sections, at most 3 questions; same no-quote check; no fallback; Lead only, not editable; the Lead writes a Note the Team sees.
- [Slice Release 2 into implementation issues](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/95): 10 slices under [Release 2: implementation](https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/issues/101); the first real Round (#94) runs alongside.

- Which R1 deferrals (map #1, "Out of scope") R2 picks up, if any.

## Out of scope

- Releases 3–5: SSO/SCIM, nested teams and roll-ups, confidential mode, audit log, exports, Slack/Teams, public API, MCP, "Ask your results".
